facts.text: PSISimplePositioner subclasses PSISimplePositionerBase and declares user_readback, user_setpoint, velocity and motor_done_move as ophyd EpicsSignal Components at suffixes R, S, V and D, and no motor_stop

PSISimplePositionerBase declares user_readback and user_setpoint as required Signals, velocity, motor_stop and motor_done_move as optional Signals, stop_value=1, done_value=1 and use_put_complete=False
The constructor accepts prefix, name, optional limits, deadband and override_suffixes

override_suffixes re-initialises a named Signal with prefix + suffix only when the class implements it; for a Signal still set to the optional sentinel it only logs that the class does not implement it
move() calls super().move(position, timeout=..., moved_cb=...), calls _setup_move(position), waits only when wait is true, and returns the MoveStatus
stop() writes stop_value to motor_stop when motor_stop is not the optional sentinel; otherwise it reads user_readback.get() and puts that value to user_setpoint, then calls super().stop
PSIDeviceBase.stop() calls on_stop(), sets stopped=True, cancels registered stoppable status objects and calls super().stop
stage() sets stopped back to False when the device is not staged
_stop_stoppable_status_objects sets a DeviceStoppedError on every registered status that is not done
_setup_move puts the target to user_setpoint without waiting and resolves the move through a TransitionStatus on motor_done_move from 0 to 1 that is registered to be cancelled on stop
The device has no built-in travel range: limits is an optional constructor argument; when it is None, check_value delegates to user_setpoint.check_value
The constructor takes an egu keyword and stores kwargs.get('egu') or an empty string in _egu

operator_required.reason: the clone states no travel range for PSISimplePositioner; the site must supply the axis envelope before a move

safe_state.description: No safe state is certified: PSISimplePositioner has no motor_stop Signal, so the native stop() writes the value read from user_readback into user_setpoint, a new target that the axis then moves to (a motor record may overshoot and return), and fails the running move status; the e-stop sends it and reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held, and nothing senses that the axis is quiescent
